view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse interior with high ceilings and industrial lighting. Pallets stacked with boxes and crates line the aisles. Forklifts operate in the background near loading docks. The floor is concrete, and metal shelving units hold additional inventory. The space appears active but organized.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall metal shelving units with blue vertical supports and yellow horizontal beams. They extend from the left wall into the aisle, holding numerous cardboard boxes on multiple levels. The shelves are partially obscured by stacked pallets in front.

objects.label: stacked pallets
objects.observation: Multiple wooden pallets piled with shrink-wrapped boxes and crates. Some are grouped near the shelving, others form stacks further back. One pallet holds a wrapped item with red tape. They sit directly on the concrete floor.

objects.label: red forklift
objects.observation: A red forklift positioned in the middle distance, facing away from the camera. It is near a stack of pallets and appears to be moving toward the right side of the frame. Its operator is visible inside the cab.

objects.label: second forklift
objects.observation: Another red forklift located further back, near the warehouse entrance. It is partially obscured by structural columns and appears stationary. The operator is visible sitting in the driver’s seat.

objects.label: ceiling lights
objects.observation: Long fluorescent light fixtures mounted on the ceiling, providing illumination. They are evenly spaced along the length of the warehouse. Their bright glow casts shadows on the floor and walls below.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth gray concrete surface covering the entire ground area. Tire marks and scuff marks are visible, indicating frequent movement of equipment. The floor extends from foreground to background, meeting the walls and pillars.

objects.label: structural pillars
objects.observation: Large cylindrical pillars supporting the warehouse roof. They are positioned along the right side and center of the frame, dividing the space. Their surfaces appear smooth and painted white or light gray.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s2-34930", "image_size": [1280, 720], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
